messages:
elaine (partnerships): Quick check — vendor-A sent the SKU list but it's super coarse. Need per-SKU hourly, reserved tiers, spot preempt % and fulfillment ETA. Can we get that into the cost model by EOD?
martin (finance): We need: list_price/hr, reserved_discount_by_tenor (3/6/12), min_commit_units, marketplace_cut_pct. Otherwise numbers blow up in sims.
sanjay (cloud-partners): I asked vendor-A for the matrix. They replied with a CSV snippet and an odd note about batch fulfillment windows. Pasting the snippet:
```
SKU,HW_FAMILY,LIST_HR,RES_3M,RES_6M,RES_12M,MIN_COMMIT,SPOT_RELIABILITY,FULFILL_DAYS
A100-80GB,v1,3.20,0.10,0.18,0.30,10,0.85,21
H100-80GB,v2,7.50,0.12,0.20,0.32,5,0.60,35
L40-48GB,v1,1.40,0.05,0.10,0.15,20,0.95,14
```
elaine (partnerships): Nice — can you also ask them to split the A100 row into reserved-block vs dedicated-pool pricing? We need to model Dedicated (fixed capacity) vs Marketplace reserved instances separately.
martin (finance): Also: do they charge an onboarding/listing fee or a percent of usage when routed from marketplace? That 3-5% swing changes our gross margin calc a lot.
ivy (product): For rollout planning: fulfillment ETA matters for Dedicated customers doing capacity commits. If vendor says 35 days for H100 but can expedite for an extra fee, we should capture expedite_pct and expedite_days.
sanjay (cloud-partners): Good call — vendor said expedite option exists: +20% list price, reduces FULFILL_DAYS by ~14. I'll capture as fields: EXPEDITE_PCT and EXPEDITE_LEAD_DAYS.
deploy-bot: new spreadsheet uploaded to //redwood-partnerships/vendor-A/sku-matrix.xlsx :thumbsup:
martin (finance): Can someone copy the spreadsheet data into the cost-model sheet (tab vendor_inputs) and add these columns: MARKETPLACE_FEE,EXPEDITE_PCT,EXPEDITE_LEAD_DAYS,PREEMPT_PROFILE (high/med/low),POOL_COMPAT (dedicated,ephemeral)
elaine (partnerships): I'll take it and push a first-pass mapping. Plan: run baseline sim with current list prices + reserved tiers, then run sensitivity with marketplace_cut +/- 3% and spot_reliability +/- 10%.
ivy (product): FYI, for Dedicated product page we'll need to show typical procurement lead times per SKU. That 21/35/14 spread is big — could affect customer SLA expectations.
sanjay (cloud-partners): I pinged vendor for SLA language and whether reserved discounts are guaranteed or subject to supply changes. They said discounts are locked only after PO + deposit. Need to model lock_probability (0/1) and refund terms.
martin (finance): Add conservative assumption: lock_probability=0.9 for now, refund_rate=0.5 of deposit if canceled pre-fulfillment. We'll flag to legal for exact contract terms.
elaine (partnerships): Great — I'll upload mapped CSV in 2 hours. After that, can someone run the sim slice for L40 and H100 to compare unit-cost at 1M tokens/day? Quick table requested. :rocket:
sanjay (cloud-partners): Will do. If anyone needs the raw CSV from the vendor, I put it in the sheet.
ivy (product): Thanks all. Small ask: mark rows where MIN_COMMIT > 10 in red so sales knows which SKUs require deeper conversations.
martin (finance): Noted. Also adding an annotation for 'ephemeral-risk' when SPOT_RELIABILITY < 0.75.
elaine (partnerships): sound plan. will follow up after i upload. :ok_hand:
